reason: CANVAS Program. The served HHF HR 0.67 (0.52-0.87) is printed in the program's heart-failure report (PMID 29526832, PMC OA, acquired and ledgered). The extractor set it aside only because that report was not in its packet. FAMILY NOTE, not a defect in the number: the estimate integrates two randomised trials, CANVAS NCT01032629 and CANVAS-R NCT01989754, both named in the report. A per-trial HHF split is not in held sources, so the row is one program-level estimate over two registered parents. Whether that may stand as one family is the family-cardinality question already raised by RLX, not decided here. The question requires trials including participants with AND without baseline HF: the report states that 14.4% had a history of HF at baseline, which ESTABLISHES that property.

population.span: The CANVAS Program integrated data from two trials involving a total of 10,142 participants with type 2 diabetes and high cardiovascular risk.

with_and_without_baseline_hf.span: Participants with a history of HF at baseline (14.4%) were more frequently women, white, and hypertensive

endpoint_estimate_ci.span: as well as hospitalized HF alone (HR, 0.67; 95% CI, 0.52–0.87).

follow_up.span: Participants in each trial were randomly assigned to receive canagliflozin or placebo and were followed for a mean of 188.2 weeks.

entry_population.why: T2D with high CV risk; 14.4% with baseline HF, so the trial includes participants with and without HF
